title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 01:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 01:00 UTC on 23 September. The 01:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 01:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.67/1M). The trailing 02:00 UTC hour is incomplete (2 samples through 02:01) and is not used as the headline hour. Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 23:02 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 23:02 UTC). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-22 20:05 UTC (357 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.33（0P），取樣 2026-09-23 01:00 UTC。01:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 01:59，時段初 0.33／0P、時段末 0.67／1M）。02:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（2 筆至 02:01），不作為主卡片整點。近 180 筆最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 23:02 UTC；標籤 1M；近 180 筆窗自 23:02 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC；標籤 1M）。窗起點 2026-09-22 20:05 UTC（357 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (01:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 01:00 UTC is 0.33/0P; the hour ends 0.67/1M at 01:59. The incomplete 02:00 hour is excluded from the headline. A 0.67/1M excursion remains in the published window (first at 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC).
